method: Replace the head branch, recut the skirt for the torso, request a geometry proposal, repaint the torso, transfer the turnaround to eight upper and lower sleeves, seat the embroidery and shape the pleats. Every stage was accepted and exported in the public browser editor.

geometryGeneration.instructions: This four-handed merchant has taken a second job leading a lantern festival orchestra. Tailor a short festive shoulder cape in warm dark teal wool or matte canvas, a visibly raised rounded collar framing the base of the neck, and a few warm brass or ochre embroidered fastenings. Keep every distinctive thing from the existing character, especially their face, glasses, grey hair, all four hands, their jar and the cut of the skirt. Design an actual flared sewn garment with a front opening and space for the arms, fitted to the existing body using its real bounds. The cape ends above the lower hands and the jar stays completely visible. Avoid shiny plastic. Preserve all existing parts as they are, add the wearable and decorations only. Keep the figure animated.

reply.summary: A flared dark teal canvas shoulder cape with an open front, raised rounded collar, ochre arc embroidery and a warm brass toggle; all original parts and animation remain intact.

paintInstructions: Tailor the EXISTING torso region alone into a beautiful, wearable festival orchestra waistcoat for this four-handed adult conductor. Replace the brown work jacket and red sweater paint with deep petrol teal woven wool, a substantial high standing ochre velvet neckband just below the head, a broad ochre placket, small paired brass fastenings, graduated gold stitched reeds sweeping upward on the left breast and quiet contrasting charcoal side panels. Keep all outside contours, waist and arm openings in precisely the same places. Use clean, graphic broad shapes readable at game size, soft diffuse light, consistent seams around all views, and restrained embroidery. No new head, arms, hands, text, straps or accessories in this surface pass. Leave the existing sculpted portrait, extra arms, jar and dark flared skirt in place.
artSource: Original ImageGen four-view revision of our own source sheet, projected only onto the torso and eight sleeves. Community images are linked in the benchmark document.
